svg.title: Glorot initialization: forward and backward variance trade-off
svg.desc: As fan-out increases from 100 to 400 while fan-in stays 100, a moving cursor follows the Glorot forward multiplier declining from 1 to 0.4 and backward multiplier increasing from 1 to 1.6. Two right-side bars track both theoretical multipliers, then return to the starting width.
svg.text: Variance propagation in a rectangular linear layer
